note: Switchable texture styles. Godot: K or the pause menu (game/scripts/styles.gd), remembered in settings.cfg [visuals] texture_style. BeamNG: export option --texture-style (baked into the facade textures). A style is offered only when all its textures exist in game/assets/textures (built by its import tool from a pack the owner downloaded). Geometry and world never change with the style.

styles.note: 1980s retro-futurist look, fully procedural: dark walls with neon windows and edges, neon grid ground, glossy black roads, glowing marks, a striped-sun sky (game/shaders/synth_sky.gdshader).

8-bit console look, fully procedural: walls and ground in world-space pixels from the NES (2C02) palette (SMB brick, grey panels, framed windows, sprite outlines), a flat blue sky with block clouds (game/shaders/nes_sky.gdshader) and a post effect with console pixels of about 480x270, black outlines from depth and normals and the palette snap (game/shaders/nes_post.gdshader, live tuning in config/visuals/nes_tune.json).
